classification.difficultyReason: Read tangent slopes and local concavity from the graph, distinguishing horizontal inflections from turning points when assigning derivative signs.

content.prompt:
Complete the table below for the function shown.
At each point, state whether the first and second derivatives are positive, negative or zero.

spec.description: Unscaled smooth curve with nine labelled points, horizontal and sloping tangent cues, curve-end arrows and positive-end axis arrows. Coordinates are schematic drawing parameters, not numerical givens.
spec.mathematics: A and G are minima; C is a maximum. B, D, F and H are non-stationary inflection points. E and I are horizontal inflection points. All vertical positions and left-to-right relationships follow the source.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source graph, labelled points and supplied tangent cues are visible.
